mapper.select: SELECT p.employee_id, p.performance_id, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.work_item, p.achievement_rate, p.title, COALESCE(ms.total_score, 0) AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p2.employee_id, YEAR(p2.end_date) AS score_year, MONTH(p2.end_date) AS score_month, SUM( ROUND(( CASE WHEN p2.achievement_rate >= 95 THEN 10 WHEN p2.achievement_rate >= 85 THEN 9 WHEN p2.achievement_rate >= 75 THEN 8 WHEN p2.achievement_rate >= 65 THEN 7 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN p2.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 7 WHEN p2.end_date <= p2.expected_end_date THEN 10 WHEN DATEDIFF(p2.end_date, p2.expected_end_date) <= 3 THEN 8 WHEN DATEDIFF(p2.end_date, p2.expected_end_date) <= 7 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END + LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p2.difficulty_score, 5), 1), 10) ) / 3.0) + CASE WHEN p2.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(pt2.weight, 0), 0), 100) / 20.0) ELSE 0 END ) AS total_score FROM performance p2 LEFT JOIN performance_team pt2 ON pt2.performance_id = p2.performance_id WHERE p2.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p2.status = 'ENDED' AND p2.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND YEAR(p2.end_date) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(p2.end_date) = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY p2.employee_id, YEAR(p2.end_date), MONTH(p2.end_date) ) ms ON ms.employee_id = p.employee_id AND ms.score_year = #{targetYear} AND ms.score_month = #{targetMonth} WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(p.end_date) = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY p.end_date DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( ROUND(( CASE WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 95 THEN 10 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 85 THEN 9 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 75 THEN 8 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 65 THEN 7 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 7 WHEN p.end_date <= p.expected_end_date THEN 10 WHEN DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) <= 3 THEN 8 WHEN DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) <= 7 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END + LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 5), 1), 10) ) / 3.0) + CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(pt.weight, 0), 0), 100) / 20.0) ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(p.end_date) = #{targetMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_performance ( employee_id, performance_year, performance_month, score, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{targetYear}, #{targetMonth}, #{score}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = #{score}, calculated_at = NOW()
